open_points.subject: Import confirmation after re-uploading identical bytes
open_points.text: A13 rule 6 says the import confirmation is bound to "the file's digest and the picks" and that "a submission's inputs are bound when their digest equals it"; A16 rule 2 says another upload replaces the confirmed file, "one of the same bytes included", and required test 3 requires confirmation after that upload to be refused "also when the new file has the same bytes". M11 records only the uploaded file and the digest-bound confirmation, with no upload identity or generation that distinguishes the two equal uploads.
open_points.question: After a confirmation step is shown, must re-uploading byte-for-byte identical content invalidate that confirmation; if so, what recorded session fact lets Registry distinguish the replacement from the confirmed upload?
options: Digest equality makes the confirmation valid after an identical re-upload, as A13 implies.
Every accepted re-upload invalidates the earlier confirmation, including identical bytes.
Registry records an upload identity or generation and binds the confirmation to it in addition to the digest.
open_points.default_guess: Treat every accepted re-upload as invalidating the pending import confirmation and record an upload generation, although neither behavior nor that fact is consistently specified.

witness.initial: One valid owner session holds import file F; Registry has shown an import confirmation bound to digest(F) and picks P.
events: The owner uploads F again with exactly the same bytes in the same session.
The owner submits the previously shown confirmation with picks P.
outcomes: A13's digest rule accepts the binding because the file digest and picks are unchanged, so the import may proceed.
A16 treats the original file as replaced and refuses the confirmation even though the replacement has the same bytes.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a successful import or a refusal requiring a new confirmation step.
